Evan (AE): quick sync — we need to finalize pilot sandbox access and success criteria. Can we lock sample data format, redaction responsibilities, and hosting option by EOD Wed? @Priya (SE) @Riley (Solutions) @Luca (Customer IT)
Priya (SE): quick q — how many sample records and what eval prompts do you want? also: will you run redaction on your side or want our redaction pipeline?
Luca (Customer IT): we can provide ~5k rows CSV + 200 annotated prompts. Need field-level pseudonymization for name/email and removal of free-text PHI. We prefer SSO + VPC peering if possible.
Riley (Solutions): got it. For redaction we can (A) accept pre-redacted CSVs, (B) run our redaction layer in ingest (we'll return a redaction report), or (C) allow you to use our client-side redaction libs. Option B is fastest for the POC but requires upload to our hosted test project.
Sam (Customer DE): what uploads do you support? S3 presigned, SFTP, or direct API? Also firewall — do we need to open source IPs?
Evan (AE): supported: S3 presigned URLs (recommended), and HTTPS API. For VPC peering / private options we can do Dedicated or Private; for hosted test we'd use presigned S3 and short retention. If you need IP allowlist: here's our ephemeral egress block: 35.209.10.0/24, 34.201.50.0/24 (example)
Priya (SE): success criteria proposal: 1) end-to-end gen for 200 prompts with sample data + 5 prompt templates; 2) p95 latency <300ms for single-turn; 3) quality: >=85% on labeled eval set; 4) redaction report shows zero raw PII in logs; 5) data ingress and rotation completed. Agree?
Luca (Customer IT): agree to criteria 1-3. For 4 we need the redaction report signed off by our privacy lead. For hosting — we cannot send raw customer IDs to hosted environment. Is Dedicated doable for a 2-week POC?
Evan (AE): Dedicated is doable as a short pilot — we typically provision a small reserved pool for 2 weeks. Pricing note: hosted POC is covered by credits; Dedicated pilots require a short-term commit or a refundable deposit. I'll put numbers in the follow-up.
Sam (Customer DE): S3 path: s3://acme-corp-poc/sample-uploads/ — we'll prepare presigned PUT URLs. Any required bucket policy?
Riley (Solutions): small suggested policy snippet: \n```\n{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/ingest"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::acme-corp-poc/sample-uploads/*"}]\n}\n```\n
Evan (AE): security checklist: send your security questionnaire to security@redwood.com. We can return SOC2, pen-test summary, and a short 30m technical call with @security-bot (ops) this week.
Priya (SE): timeline (working days): Day 0: kickoff + creds; Day 1-2: data handoff + redaction; Day 3-4: model routing + smoke tests; Day 5-6: eval run and metrics; Day 7: wrap & success sign-off. Total ~7 business days.
Luca (Customer IT): timeline ok. We need the signed redaction SLA before data handoff. Can you share the SLA doc?
Evan (AE): yes — attaching SLA doc in follow-up. Quick ask: can you confirm which field names need redaction (name,email,ssn,notes) and the sample CSV header? once we have that we'll schedule provisioning.
Sam (Customer DE): headers: id,name,email,account_id,notes,created_at
Priya (SE): perfect. I'll draft the eval prompt set and share a small harness (python) to run locally. Example prompt to include: "Summarize the customer's support ticket and suggest next actions." keep prompts short.
Luca (Customer IT): thanks. last question — logs: retention during POC? we need logs retained max 7 days and accessible to us.
Riley (Solutions): during pilot we set retention to 7d by default and can provide export of logs. We'll also enable KV cache flush between tests.
Evan (AE): great — next steps: I'll share pricing for Dedicated pilot, Security will get the questionnaire, and Priya will drop the eval harness. Target: provision by Mon next week. :thumbsup:
security-bot: scheduled 30m call with Customer IT for Fri 10:00am UTC — join if needed.
